title: Binance Completes the Alpine F1® Team Fan Token Subscription Launchpad and Will Open Trading for ALPINE
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the subscription format Launchpad for Alpine F1® Team Fan Token and the final token allocation results are now showing on the  Alpine F1® Team Fan Token Launchpad Page . A total of 126,924 participants committed 8,164,773.8827 BNB during the subscription period, representing an oversubscription of 798x.  75 participants reached the 10,000 ALPINE hard cap, resulting in the participants’ allocation being passed down to the remaining users. For further information on how this is calculated, refer to a detailed guide  here . As a reference for users that participated: Users that committed 50 BNB received an allocation of 26.02455927 ALPINE and will have 0.06655911 BNB deducted. Users that committed 500 BNB received an allocation of 260.24559281 ALPINE, and will have 0.66559112 BNB deducted. Users that committed 5,000 BNB received an allocation of 2,602.45592816 ALPINE and will have 6.65591116 BNB deducted. The corresponding BNB tokens will be deducted from your already-locked BNB balance within 30 minutes of this announcement. Once deducted, your ALPINE and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Binance will list Alpine F1® Team Fan Token (ALPINE) in the innovation zone and open trading for ALPINE/BTC, ALPINE/EUR, ALPINE/TRY and ALPINE/USDT trading pairs at 2022-02-21 12:00 PM (UTC). Note: The token purchase price was set at 1 ALPINE = 0.00255755 BNB or 1 USD (using a BNB price of 391.00 USD), as per the previous announcement  here . The Alpine F1® Team Fan Token (ALPINE) BEP-20 smart contract is available  here .
